boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Niagara University spaces where official university sources document study, recreation, arts, worship, meetings, or student programming.

cards.title: Gallagher Center Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Gallagher Center
cards.notes: Use the lower level as a practical meet-up point for food, a study break, or a relaxed conversation before campus activities.
cards.short_summary: The student-center floor combines dining with space to meet, study, and relax.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University describes the Gallagher Center’s lower level as a student-life space where students can eat, meet classmates, study, and relax.
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of the Gallagher Center; campus offices and dining are adjacent.

cards.title: Gallagher Center Multi-Purpose Room
cards.subtitle: Gallagher Center lower level
cards.notes: Check the campus activities schedule for a program, fair, lecture, or Friday Late Nite Niagara event held in this reservable room.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room used for large student programs, fairs, lectures, and Late Nite Niagara.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University identifies the MPR as the primary home for its Friday-night Late Nite Niagara programming and as a venue for student programs, fairs, lectures, and meetings.
cards.access_notes: Programs vary; the room is reserved through the university’s Ad Astra scheduling system.

cards.title: Student Clubs & Organizations Office
cards.subtitle: Gallagher Center lower level
cards.notes: Stop in when organizing a club meeting or looking for a shared workspace with computers, a board room, cabinets, and a lounge.
cards.short_summary: A club home base with meeting, computer, storage, and lounge space.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University says the Student Clubs & Organizations Office has a 12-person board room, computers, club cabinets, and a lounge area.
cards.access_notes: The office is in the Gallagher Center lower level and serves student clubs and organizations.

cards.title: Niagara University Library
cards.subtitle: South end of campus
cards.notes: Bring a project, reading, or research task and choose individual or collaborative work space; ask the help desk when technology stalls.
cards.short_summary: The library supports research alongside individual and collaborative work and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University states that its library provides access to technology and information resources plus individual and collaborative work and study space.
cards.access_notes: Library services and access can vary by term; consult the library before planning a visit.

cards.title: Kiernan Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation complex
cards.notes: Plan a workout, open swim, court session, or intramural activity, then confirm hours and any event-related restrictions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An all-in-one recreation complex with fitness, courts, pool, studios, and fields.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University lists a lap pool, basketball courts, racquetball court, free-weight room, fitness center, studios, and outdoor fields at Kiernan.
cards.access_notes: Student use is the center’s focus; use may be restricted for university events and activities.

cards.title: Castellani Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Center of campus
cards.notes: Walk through the galleries between classes, or look for exhibitions and programs that connect campus learning with the museum collection.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus art museum with year-round exhibitions and public programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University says the Castellani Art Museum has a collection of more than 5,000 works and offers year-round exhibitions, public programs, and educational experiences.
cards.access_notes: The university states that student access is free with an NU ID card.

cards.title: Alumni Chapel
cards.subtitle: Alumni Hall
cards.notes: If spiritual reflection or worship fits your day, check the campus ministry calendar and attend a scheduled service or prayer opportunity.
cards.short_summary: Campus Ministry’s worship space hosts scheduled Mass and spiritual-life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University lists weekday and Sunday Mass at Alumni Chapel and describes prayer, meditation, retreats, and student-led service opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Weekday Mass is listed for the academic year at 12:15 p.m.; Sunday Mass is listed at 11 a.m.

cards.title: Dwyer Arena
cards.subtitle: Campus athletic facility
cards.notes: Look at the athletics schedule for a game or event, and use the arena lobby as your arrival point when the building is open.
cards.short_summary: A 2,100-seat arena with athletic lounges, locker rooms, and a large lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University describes Dwyer Arena as a 2,100-seat facility with athletic lounges, locker rooms, equipment storage, and a large lobby.
cards.source_title: Meeting Space and Athletic Facilities | Niagara University
cards.access_notes: Event and public-entry arrangements vary; check the hosting athletics or university event listing.

cards.title: Niagara Field
cards.subtitle: Behind Kiernan Center
cards.notes: Use the field for scheduled campus gatherings, and check student-life announcements for community events held behind the recreation center.
cards.short_summary: A named field behind Kiernan Center used for orientation-week community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University’s new-student orientation schedule identifies Niagara Field, behind Kiernan Center, as the location for the clubs fair, opening celebration, and fireworks viewing.
cards.source_title: Niagara University New Student Orientation Schedule 2025
cards.access_notes: Use is event-dependent; confirm access and timing through current university announcements.

cards.entity_name: Elizabeth Ann Clune Center for Theatre
cards.title: Elizabeth Ann Clune Center for Theatre
cards.subtitle: Leary Theatre
cards.notes: Check the theatre season and attend a scheduled production to see student performers apply work developed through their classes.
cards.short_summary: The home of Niagara University Theatre’s varied seasonal productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University says its theatre productions give students opportunities to apply knowledge, skills, and techniques explored in class.
cards.access_notes: Attendance depends on the announced production schedule and ticketing or entry details.
